ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Усилие» (usilie, 'effort') is kept as 'effort' in every occurrence, as the day's theme; «благо» (blago) is 'the good' and «закон бога» (zakon boga) 'the law of God'. The Babi passage keeps the generic 'man … he' where the website draft had 'humans … they'; the attribution «Таблички бабидов» (Tablichki babidov) is 'Tablets of the Babis'.
Source observation: [15] The attribution «Лao-Тсе» is typed with Latin «a» and «o» inside the Cyrillic name (transcription slip); translated as 'Laozi.'
